svg.title: Cabloy Admin Implementation Roadmap
svg.desc: Implementation Roadmap. 33 formal WBS tasks. Current derived status reviewed 2026-10-05. Relative positions and overlap are illustrative; they are not calendar dates, duration, staffing, or concurrency commitments. Dependency readiness is not execution approval; descriptive gates still require review.
svg.metadata: Derived from pdp-wbs.md, test-plan.md, and progress.md. This SVG is not planning authority.
